kildefunksjon: one transparent blink-overlay cel containing exactly two separate flat pink eyelid fill marks, side-view spacing
kildedetaljer: The source is a 6 by 1 original-pixel eye-blink overlay: a solid 2 by 1 pink mark, a transparent 2 by 1 gap, and a solid 2 by 1 pink mark, all on one horizontal baseline. These marks briefly replace only the two eye apertures in the complete head; they are not eyes, highlights or detached objects. Draw exactly these two smooth flat pink marks with the same spacing and width-to-height proportions, solid source skin color RGB(255,139,115), no black outline, no eyes, pupils, eyelashes, shadows or extra facial parts. They must be fully opaque inside with real transparent space around and between. Keep their flat top and bottom and almost rectangular short shapes, with only subpixel antialiasing at the outer edge. The source proportions are essential: total occupied extent 6:1 and each mark 2:1. Enlarge uniformly for the drawing; do not make tall rounded capsules.
